# Language Threshold

Language Threshold provides role-specific language training for nurses, construction foremen, teams, coaches, and missionaries.

## Main pages
- App and free lessons: https://app.languagethreshold.com/
- Pricing: https://app.languagethreshold.com/pricing
- Team training: https://app.languagethreshold.com/team
- Support: https://app.languagethreshold.com/support
- Founder story: https://languagethreshold.com/founder

## Product facts
- 660+ role-specific lessons.
- Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Pashto, Chinese, and English for Work are available in the app.
- Practice includes bilingual reading, AI conversation practice, listening drills, and Field Prep roleplay.
- Individual plans include a 7-day free trial; checkout shows payment and renewal terms.
